attributeDefinition: Date the seine sample was collected.

Identifier of the seine sample (one seine survey at one location on one date). From the source database sample ID for 2008-2025 and the source seine ID for 1997-2001. REVIEW: IDs are not unique across source periods (399 values are reused), so identify a sample by date + location + sample_id.

Name of the sampling location as recorded in the source data. Raw names are kept (spelling and format vary by source period and include side-channel, bank and upstream/downstream qualifiers); use river_mile to group locations by site.

Feather River channel the location is in: HFC (High Flow Channel), LFC (Low Flow Channel), or 'HFC DS LYR'. REVIEW: confirm the meaning of 'HFC DS LYR' (likely downstream of the Yuba River confluence). Not recorded for 1997-2014 data or a small number of 2015-2025 records.
Sampling gear type. All records are beach seine (SEIN); other gear types in the source data (nets, electrofishing) were removed.
Description of the beach seine used, by net length in feet (10, 25, 39, 50 or 100 foot beach seine with bag).
Condition rating recorded by the crew for the survey: good, fair or poor; 'n/p' as entered in the source data. REVIEW: confirm what is being rated and the meaning of 'n/p' (assumed 'not provided').

Water temperature at the time of sampling. 1997-2001 values were recorded in degrees Fahrenheit and converted to Celsius (a recorded value of 0 was treated as not recorded); a single entry of 147 for sample 1628 was corrected to 17 per the data owner.

Secchi depth, recorded in 1997-2001 data only (source column 'sechi'). REVIEW: about 99% of values are 0, which likely means not recorded, and units are not documented - confirm units or remove this column.

Common name of the fish species (lower case) as standardized from source codes and spellings. Includes unidentified groups (e.g. unidentified juvenile minnow) and the composite 'sacramento pikeminnow or hardhead'. Chinook salmon and O. mykiss are not split by race or origin here; see run and adipose_clipped. Blank where no fish were caught.
missingValueCodeExplanation: No fish caught or species not recorded

attributeDefinition: Fork length of the fish (1997-2001: individual fish; 2008-2025: length of the fish or length class counted in count), in millimeters. Blank where fish were counted but not measured (a recorded length of 0 was set to missing).

Life stage of salmonids recorded by the crew: yolk-sac fry, fry, parr, silvery parr, between parr and smolt, smolt, or adult; 'n/p' as entered in the source data (assumed 'not provided'). Recorded for salmonids only.
Chinook salmon run (Fall, Spring, Late Fall, Winter or Unknown), taken from the species entry in the source data. Blank for all non-Chinook records.

Length of the seine haul. REVIEW (units differ by source period): 1997-2001 values appear to be in feet (e.g. round values such as 35 and 15 for a 39 ft seine), 2008-2025 values appear to be in meters (e.g. 4.572 = 15 ft). Not yet harmonized in the clean data - confirm with data owner. Source columns: 'length' (1997-2001) and 'bs_start_length' (2008-2025).

Width of the seine haul at close of the haul. REVIEW (units differ by source period): 1997-2001 values appear to be in feet (e.g. round values such as 35 and 15 for a 39 ft seine), 2008-2025 values appear to be in meters (e.g. 4.572 = 15 ft). Not yet harmonized in the clean data - confirm with data owner. Source column 'bs_close_width' (2008-2025). REVIEW: 2015-2025 values are 0 to 0.6 and about 98% are missing, which does not look like a haul width.

Distance from the bank that the seine was deployed. REVIEW (units differ by source period): 1997-2001 values appear to be in feet (e.g. round values such as 35 and 15 for a 39 ft seine), 2008-2025 values appear to be in meters (e.g. 4.572 = 15 ft). Not yet harmonized in the clean data - confirm with data owner. REVIEW: confirm the exact definition.
Water depth at the haul point farthest from shore ('full distance out'), recorded in 1997-2001 data only. REVIEW: depth units are probably feet for this period - confirm.
Water depth at the haul point closest to shore, recorded in 1997-2001 data only. REVIEW: depth units are probably feet for this period - confirm.
Stream feature (mesohabitat unit) of the sampled area: Riffle, Run, Glide or Pool, or a combination joined with '&' where more than one was recorded.

Area of the sampled haul. REVIEW (inconsistent between periods): 1997-2001 values are supplied in the source data and equal haul length x width; 2008-2025 values were calculated as length x width x average depth, which is a volume. Only 43 values exist for 2015-2025 and all are 0 because width is mostly missing. Confirm the definition and units before publishing.
Number of fish of this species (and length, where measured) in the record. Blank for 1997-2001 data, where each row is one individual fish.
missingValueCodeExplanation: Not recorded (1997-2001 rows are individual fish)

attributeDefinition: Average water depth of the haul. REVIEW (units differ by source period): 1997-2001 values appear to be in feet (e.g. round values such as 35 and 15 for a 39 ft seine), 2008-2025 values appear to be in meters (e.g. 4.572 = 15 ft). Not yet harmonized in the clean data - confirm with data owner. Source column 'bs_depth_1_2', confirmed by the data owner to be the average depth. Two entries missing a decimal point (samples 899 and 1066) were corrected.
missingValueCodeExplanation: Not recorded (1997-2001 data) or not entered

attributeDefinition: Weight of the fish, in grams. Recorded in 2015-2025 data only.
Calendar year of the sample, derived from date.

River mile of the standardized river-mile site assigned to the sampling location, measured in miles upstream from the Feather River's confluence with the Sacramento River (REVIEW: confirm RM 0 definition). Locations were assigned to a site using the program's Subsite Table, supplemented by manual assignments.
Number of seine hauls (pulls) made in the sample, parsed from free-text crew comments (e.g. '2 pulls'). Blank when no count was stated in the comments, which does not imply a single haul.

Substrate types present in the sampled area, as comma-separated categories: Fine (small gravel, 0-50 mm), Small (medium gravel, 50-150 mm), Medium (large cobble, 150-300 mm), Boulder (>300 mm) or Pavement (boat ramp). All substrate present is recorded; the order listed does not indicate dominance.

Cover types present in the sampled area, as comma-separated categories (e.g. No Apparent Cover, Small Instream Objects/Woody Debris, Large Instream Objects/Woody Debris, Overhead Objects, Submerged Aquatic Veg/Algae, Undercut Bank). All cover present is recorded; the order listed does not indicate dominance.
Whether the fish had a clipped adipose fin (TRUE/FALSE), derived from the species entry in the source data. Blank where not applicable or not recorded.
